text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby—

"Beginning with the Derby and ending with 
the Derby." It's safe to say the Twinkle 
Series revolves around the Derby.

Many enter the world of racing dreaming of 
becoming a Derby Umamusume or a Derby 
Trainer.

The Japanese Derby approaches once more 
this year— Just ahead of it, a special 
lecture by Saint Lite was being held for 
Classic-tier Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
—An Umamusume's prime is fleeting, like a 
flower... and all the more beautiful for 
it.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Most will enter the Classic stage with 
their spirits high... and carrying 
inexhaustible power.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
—However, that period lasts for only a 
single year. Furthermore, when it comes to 
Classic races... there are no rematches.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, the 
Kikuka Sho. If you drop even one, you will 
never again—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: ...She cannot achieve the "Triple Tiara."

In that instant, the venue falls dead 
silent. Yet, Saint Lite's tone remains 
calm—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
The pressure mounting with one crown, then 
two. Cherished dreams, expectations, 
wishes, prayers, records...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
...Everything bears down on a single 
person.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
The weight of it all... is something only 
those who have carried it can understand.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely for this reason that the 
"Triple Crown" is deemed a crown.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Therefore— Whosoever achieves this is 
worthy of being King.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone, there is something 
important I must tell you.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby... I am sure it will 
be held without any issues this year as 
well."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
It means that without a doubt, a new Derby 
Umamusume will be born.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
The Derby is 2,400 meters... It is run at 
the classic distance, which is adopted in 
world-class races.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
The one who emerges victorious here has 
truly conquered the royal road.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Now then……――

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
You are well aware that the Derby is the 
dream of everyone involved in racing.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Some may only refer to me as a Derby 
Umamusume.
—St Lite won the Derby by 8 lengths.

A field of top Umamusume of that 
generation with closely matched abilities— 
the margin of victory that day still 
leaves a lasting shock to this modern era.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: I can say this with absolute certainty.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Victory at the Japan Derby is a monumental 
honor.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to etch your mark upon 
history, then train diligently, aim high, 
and act with conviction.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: "There is no greater honor than that."

—Before the majestic presence of St Lite, 
nobody could even flinch.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
St. Lite's manner of speaking really 
carries a lot of dignity.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Were we going to compile what we just 
talked about and release it to the fans?
choice_data_list: Yes, I'll upload it to social media.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I see. I'm not very familiar with the 
internet, you see... I'll leave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
That student introduction video you 
uploaded before was really well received 
too, wasn't it?♪

The video released before the first "Dream 
Fest" saw its view count surge after the 
race.
choice_data_list:
I was hoping it would help with publicity 
again this time...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are on the Twinkle Series right 
now, so I'm sure everyone will be watching 
you!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It seems the other Umamusume and Trainers 
have taken the initiative to act on their 
own as well. I couldn't be more grateful.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"No... surely, it won't just stop at 
that."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Still, seeing that determined look on the 
students' faces... It's given me another 
race to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm so glad!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Getting to challenge the Derby from now 
on... I'm kind of jealous, haha.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Because the Derby's glory slipped 
right through our fingers, after all."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I admired it, and desperately 
wanted to live up to everyone's 
expectations, but...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I fell ill, you see. Finishing 
in 8th place back then... Well, I doubt 
I'll ever forget it.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
It turns out I have quite a lot of people 
cheering for me too...
choice_data_list:
She was the overwhelming favorite, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's the Derby, so I was determined 
to answer everyone's expectations, but...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"The girl who won was, reeeeeeeally 
strong!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she was really strong...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
I was terribly frustrated back then, but 
because she became my rival, I think 
that's why I was able to work so hard.
choice_data_list:
I think the heated battles are part of 
what makes the Derby so charming

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: You're right. Speaking of Derby rivalries—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right! And also, that Derby 
back then was――
choice_data_list: (They both look like they're having fun.)
(They both look like they're having fun)

text_block_list.text:
"A victory that even those two legendary 
figures could not seize... Yet, the reason 
they can still speak of it with dreamy 
eyes is—"

Because the Derby is special, after all. 
And for <chrname>, who is about to take on the 
challenge, there is no doubt that...
choice_data_list: (...I want to lead her to victory!)

text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just race personnel. Excitement 
for the Nippon Derby and the Classic 
Triple Crown was growing day by day among 
the general public as well—

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That video of St. Lite was amazing~! I 
feel like that's the first time I've ever 
seen her speak. I got so hyped!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Um, is the Triple Crown or the Derby 
really that amazing?

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent honor, huh... I wonder if my 
fave feels the same way.

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Any Umamusume would dream of 
running in that race.

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Only a limited number of Umamusume can 
run. A once-in-a-lifetime chance in the 
Classic Class, standing at the pinnacle of 
7,000 contenders—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But wasn't <nickname>-chan's goal something 
other than the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: "That's probably why. ...Right?"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: ? Umm, what does that mean...?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Remember the way St. Lite spoke.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown route... Aside 
from the Derby, you hadn't mentioned it at 
all, right?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I deliberately lit a fire under her—though 
in her case, I can't completely rule out 
that she truly meant it...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Regardless, after being spoken to like 
that... what Umamusume could possibly stay 
silent—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Damn it all! I won't lose! The Oaks is a 
Classic race, too...! It's a race with 
real history!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“—The brilliance of the Triple Tiara! It 
outshines even the Crown...!”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Seems like nobody knows. The NHK 
Mile Cup is the fastest... which means 
it's the greatest!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Racing is all about swiftness! Speed is 
the proof of a king...! —A magnificent 
honor!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"The passion of dirt racing, its path... 
The time has finally come to show it to 
the world."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Down this path we believed in! We shall 
show them our own kind of... "Crown"!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: —I can practically see the flames roaring.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
A run that rivals the Derby... The desire 
to put on an unforgettable show—
choice_data_list: I'm sure <nickname> feels the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: I see. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Races other than the Derby will definitely 
be just as exciting. —The fans will surely 
feel it♪

True to those words... the next day, upon 
arriving at the Race Cafe—

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Um, there's something I've been 
thinking about lately. It seems like my 
fave isn't aiming for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't really thinking much of it at 
first, but... I watched St. Lite's video.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that just got me thinking... Maybe 
the path of an idol fan is pretty great 
too? And, like, so much more...

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, that's completely fine! You 
follow the path you believe in, and 
believe in and support your fave.

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She said she's gonna run a race even 
hotter than the Derby! I know she's 
totally fired up for it!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Um, what we were talking about 
earlier... Could you tell me more about 
the Triple Crown and stuff?

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I want to know! More... so much more about 
racing...!

I reaffirmed my conviction that continuing 
to share the appeal of the Twinkle 
Series... and the thrilling excitement of 
racing, is essential for our future.
